title: Lemon & Oregano Chicken Traybake
blurb: One roasting tin of chicken thighs, potatoes and lemon — skin crisps up, everything else looks after itself.
method: Heat oven to 200°C.
Toss potatoes, onion and garlic with half the oil in a roasting tin; roast 15 min.
Add chicken thighs, remaining oil, oregano, salt and pepper, and lemon wedges. Toss to coat.
Roast 30–35 min until chicken is golden and potatoes are tender.
Scatter with olives and parsley before serving.
Serve with a simple green salad.

title: Baked Sea Bream with Fennel & Orange
blurb: Whole fish over shaved fennel and orange — bakes in one dish, tastes like a coastal holiday.
ingredients: 1 whole sea bream, gutted and scaled
60g rocket or mixed salad leaves, to serve
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Parboil the potatoes 8 min until just tender; drain.
Toss fennel and potatoes with half the oil and a pinch of salt in a baking dish.
Score the fish 2–3 times each side; stuff cavities with orange slices, garlic and dill.
Lay fish over the fennel and potatoes, drizzle with remaining oil and orange juice.
Bake 25–30 min until the fish flakes easily and potatoes are tender.
Serve with rocket or salad leaves.

title: Shakshuka with Feta & Herbs
blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce — a fast, protein-rich dinner (or breakfast-for-dinner).
method: Soften onion and pepper in oil, 6–7 min. Add garlic and spices, cook 1 min.
Pour in tomatoes, simmer 8 min until thickened.
Make three wells in the sauce, crack in eggs, cover and cook 6–8 min until whites are set.
Scatter with feta and herbs.
Serve with warm crusty bread for dipping.

title: Lamb & Chickpea Kofta with Tzatziki
blurb: Spiced lamb skewers with a cooling cucumber-yoghurt sauce and a crunchy chopped salad.
ingredients: 1/2 x 400g tin chickpeas, drained and mashed
method: Mix lamb, mashed chickpeas, spices, onion and seasoning; shape onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry 10–12 min, turning, until cooked through.
Stir grated cucumber (squeezed dry), garlic and mint into yoghurt for tzatziki.
Warm the pittas.
Serve with the salad and warmed pittas.

title: Tonno e Fagioli (White Bean & Tuna Salad)
blurb: A five-minute Italian pantry salad — good tinned tuna, cannellini beans, red onion and lemon.
ingredients: 1 x 160g tin good-quality tuna in olive oil
method: Soak sliced onion in the lemon juice for 10 min to mellow it.
Toss beans, tuna (with its oil), onion, lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.
Season well and serve over rocket with tomatoes and crusty bread.

title: Roasted Vegetable, Chickpea & Halloumi Bowl
blurb: Traybake vegetables and chickpeas with griddled halloumi and a lemon-tahini drizzle.
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Toss vegetables and chickpeas with oil and cumin; roast 25 min.
Meanwhile cook the couscous according to packet instructions; fluff with a fork.
Griddle halloumi slices 2 min per side until golden.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a splash of water to a drizzling consistency.
Assemble bowls over the couscous and drizzle over.

title: Joojeh Kabab (Saffron-Lime Chicken Skewers)
blurb: Yoghurt-and-saffron marinated chicken, grilled until charred, with tomatoes and flatbread.
ingredients: Pinch saffron, bloomed in 1 tbsp hot water
method: Mix yoghurt, saffron water, grated onion, citrus juice and oil; marinate chicken at least 2 hours (or overnight).
Thread onto skewers with tomatoes.
Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Grill or griddle skewers 12–15 min, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve over rice with the warmed flatbread and diced cucumber.

title: Kuku Sabzi (Herb & Walnut Frittata)
blurb: A dense, deeply green herb frittata — parsley, coriander and dill baked with eggs and walnuts.
ingredients: Sliced tomatoes and cucumber, to serve
method: Heat oven to 180°C. Whisk eggs with turmeric and seasoning.
Stir in all the chopped herbs, spring onion and walnuts.
Pour into an oiled ovenproof pan, bake 22–25 min until just set.
Cool slightly and cut into wedges; good warm or cold.
Serve with warmed flatbread, yoghurt and sliced tomatoes and cucumber.

title: Persian-Spiced Salmon with Saffron & Barberries
blurb: Salmon fillets glazed with saffron and lime, finished with tart barberries and pistachio.
ingredients: Pinch saffron, bloomed in 1 tbsp hot water
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Mix saffron water, oil and lime juice; brush over salmon.
Pan-fry or bake fillets 8–10 min until just cooked.
Meanwhile steam the green beans 4–5 min until just tender.
Soak barberries in warm water 5 min, drain, and scatter over with pistachios.
Serve salmon and green beans over the rice.

title: Adas Polo-Style Lentil Rice with Spiced Beef
blurb: Basmati layered with spiced lentils, dates and crispy onions, topped with cinnamon-spiced ground beef.
ingredients: Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve
method: Cook lentils in salted water 15–18 min until just tender; drain.
Parboil rice 6 min, drain.
Fry sliced onion in 1 tbsp oil until deep golden and crisp; set aside.
Brown beef with diced onion and spices, 8–10 min.
Layer rice and lentils in a pan with remaining oil, dates and raisins; steam 15 min on low heat, lid wrapped in a tea towel.
Serve topped with beef and crispy onions, with sliced cucumber and tomato alongside.

title: Herb & Bean Stew (Ghormeh Sabzi-Inspired, Chicken)
blurb: A lighter, chicken-based take on the classic herb stew — parsley, coriander, fenugreek and kidney beans.
ingredients: 1/2 x 400g tin red kidney beans, drained
method: Fry onion in oil until soft; add chicken and brown lightly.
Add chopped herbs and fenugreek, cook 5 min to soften.
Add kidney beans, dried limes (pierced) and enough water to just cover; simmer, covered, 30–35 min.
Meanwhile cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Season to taste and serve over rice.

title: Ginger-Scallion Steamed Sea Bass
blurb: Cantonese-style whole fish steamed until silky, topped with sizzling ginger and spring onion oil.
ingredients: 1 whole sea bass, scaled and gutted
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Score the fish, place on a heatproof plate with half the ginger inside the cavity.
Steam over boiling water 10–12 min until just cooked, steaming or stir-frying the greens alongside for the last 3–4 min.
Scatter remaining ginger and spring onion over the fish; pour over soy sauce and wine.
Heat oil until smoking and pour over to sizzle.
Serve over rice with the greens.

title: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sesame Greens
blurb: A sticky three-ingredient miso glaze under the grill, with quick sesame-garlic greens.
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Mix miso, honey and vinegar; spread over salmon and marinate 10 min if time allows.
Grill salmon 8–10 min until glazed and cooked through.
Stir-fry greens with garlic and sesame oil 3–4 min.
Serve together over rice, scattered with sesame seeds.

title: Chicken & Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
blurb: A everyday wok dinner — lean chicken, crunchy vegetables, a light garlic-ginger sauce.
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until golden, 5–6 min; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables 3–4 min until just tender-crisp.
Return chicken, add ginger, garlic, soy and honey; toss 1–2 min.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Beef & Broccoli Lettuce Wraps
blurb: Quick stir-fried beef and broccoli in a light sauce, wrapped in crisp lettuce instead of rice.
method: Toss beef with cornflour and a splash of soy sauce.
Stir-fry beef in hot oil 2–3 min until browned; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli 3 min, add ginger, garlic, remaining soy and vinegar.
Return beef, toss to coat, and serve in lettuce leaves.

title: Tofu & Vegetable Red Curry from Scratch
blurb: Fresh red chillies, lemongrass, galangal and garlic make the aromatic base; no ready-made curry paste.
ingredients: 1–2 red chillies, deseeded for less heat
1 lemongrass stalk, tender centre finely sliced
15g galangal, peeled and finely chopped (or ginger)
10g fresh coriander, leaves and stems separated
method: Cook rice following the packet instructions. Blitz chillies, lemongrass, galangal, shallot, garlic, coriander stems, spices and lime zest with 2–3 tbsp water into a fine homemade paste.
Heat oil and fry the aromatic mixture for 3–4 minutes, stirring. Add coconut milk and 100ml water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add pepper and beans and simmer for 8–10 minutes until tender. Add tofu and simmer for another 5 minutes until hot throughout.
Season with soy sauce and lime juice to taste. Scatter with coriander leaves and serve with rice.

title: Thai Chicken Larb Salad
blurb: Minced chicken tossed with lime, fish sauce, chilli, mint and toasted rice powder — bright and light.
ingredients: Little gem lettuce leaves, to serve
method: Dry-fry chicken mince in a hot pan, breaking it up, until cooked, 6–8 min.
Off the heat, stir in fish sauce, lime juice, chilli and shallots.
Toss through herbs and rice powder just before serving.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber slices.

title: Vietnamese Turmeric Fish with Dill (Cha Ca)
blurb: Firm white fish pan-fried with turmeric and dill, finished with peanuts and fresh herbs over rice noodles.
ingredients: 250g firm white fish (cod or haddock), cubed
method: Marinate fish with turmeric, ginger, garlic and fish sauce for 15 min.
Cook the rice noodles according to packet instructions; drain.
Pan-fry fish in oil 3–4 min until nearly cooked.
Add spring onion and dill, toss 1–2 min until fish is just done.
Serve over rice noodles with beansprouts and lettuce leaves, scattered with peanuts.

title: Grilled Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
blurb: Charred spiced white fish, crunchy lime slaw and a light yoghurt crema in warm corn tortillas.
method: Rub fish with paprika, cumin, half the lime juice and seasoning; grill or pan-fry 3–4 min per side.
Toss cabbage and carrot with remaining lime juice.
Mix yoghurt with chipotle for the crema.
Warm tortillas, flake in fish, top with slaw, crema and coriander.

title: Chicken Tinga Lettuce & Corn Cups
blurb: Shredded chicken simmered in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce — served in lettuce or warm tortillas.
method: Poach chicken in water until cooked, 12–15 min; shred with two forks.
Soften onion and garlic in oil, add tomatoes, chipotle and cumin, simmer 10 min.
Stir in shredded chicken, simmer 5 min more to absorb the sauce.
Serve in lettuce cups or tortillas with avocado and warmed black beans.

title: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
blurb: Roasted spiced sweet potato and black beans, lime crema and pickled red onion in soft tortillas.
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Toss sweet potato with spices and oil; roast 25 min until tender.
Soak red onion in lime juice 10 min to quick-pickle.
Warm black beans through.
Fill tortillas with sweet potato, beans, pickled onion, yoghurt and coriander.

title: Carne Asada with Pico de Gallo & Charred Corn
blurb: Citrus-marinated grilled steak, sliced thin, with a fresh tomato-lime salsa and blackened corn.
method: Marinate steak in lime juice, garlic, cumin and a little oil for 30 min to overnight.
Mix tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, coriander and a squeeze of lime for pico de gallo.
Grill steak 3–4 min per side (medium), rest 5 min, then slice thinly against the grain.
Char corn on the grill or a dry pan; serve alongside with warmed tortillas.

title: Prawn & Avocado Ceviche-Style Salad
blurb: Cooked prawns tossed with fresh citrus, tomato, chilli and avocado; a bright, quick salad.
method: Toss chilled cooked prawns with lime and lemon juice; refrigerate for 10 minutes while preparing the vegetables.
Drain off most of the juice, then fold through tomato, onion, jalapeño and coriander.
Fold in avocado just before serving.
Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Chipotle Chicken & Vegetable Skewers
blurb: Smoky marinated chicken and peppers on the grill, finished with lime and a scatter of coriander.
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Marinate chicken in chipotle, lime juice, oil and cumin for at least 20 min.
Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill 12–14 min, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and coriander, and serve over rice.

title: Cod with Tomato, Chickpeas & Spinach
blurb: Flaky cod simmered in fresh garlic, tomatoes and chickpeas, with spinach and lemon.
method: Soften the onion in olive oil in a wide lidded pan for 6 minutes. Add garlic and paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and drained chickpeas; simmer for 7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Nestle the cod into the sauce, cover and gently simmer for 7–9 minutes until opaque and flaking easily.
Fold spinach into the sauce around the fish for 2 minutes. Finish with lemon and parsley and divide between two bowls.

title: Paprika Chicken with Lemon Bulgur Salad
blurb: Quick pan-seared chicken over bulgur, cucumber, tomatoes and a lemon-parsley dressing.
ingredients: 300g chicken breast, cut into thin strips
method: Cover bulgur with boiling water following the packet ratio, cover and leave for 15 minutes or until tender; drain any excess water.
Toss chicken with paprika, garlic, lemon zest and half the oil. Pan-fry for 8–10 minutes, turning, until cooked through with no pink centre.
Mix bulgur with cucumber, tomatoes, spring onions, parsley, remaining oil and lemon juice. Season to taste.
Divide the salad between two plates and top with chicken.

title: Roasted Aubergine with Lentils & Lemon Yoghurt
blurb: Cumin-roasted aubergine, warm lentils and tomatoes, finished with a homemade garlic yoghurt.
method: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss aubergine and onion with oil, cumin, salt and pepper on a baking tray.
Roast for 20 minutes, turn, then add tomatoes and roast for another 10 minutes until the aubergine is tender.
Warm the drained lentils in a saucepan with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes. Mix yoghurt with garlic and half the lemon juice.
Toss lentils with the roasted vegetables, parsley and remaining lemon juice. Serve with the yoghurt.

title: Sumac Chicken with Herby Rice & Shirazi Salad
blurb: Tangy sumac chicken, dill rice and a crisp cucumber-tomato salad dressed with fresh lime.
ingredients: 300g boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into strips
method: Cook basmati rice following the packet instructions. While it cooks, toss chicken with sumac, turmeric, garlic and half the oil.
Pan-fry the chicken for 10–12 minutes, turning, until cooked through with no pink centre.
Mix cucumber, tomatoes and red onion with lime juice, remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Fold dill through the rice and serve with chicken and the salad.

title: Herb-Baked Trout with Saffron Potatoes
blurb: Trout fillets topped with fresh dill and parsley, served with saffron potatoes and green beans.
ingredients: Pinch saffron, soaked in 2 tbsp hot water
method: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil potatoes for 15–18 minutes until tender.
Put trout skin-side down in a small baking dish. Mix herbs, garlic, lemon zest and half the oil and spread over the fish.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the trout is opaque and flakes easily. Steam the green beans for 5–6 minutes.
Drain potatoes and toss with saffron water and remaining oil. Serve with trout, beans and lemon juice.

title: Spinach & Chickpea Stew with Dill Rice
blurb: A quick Persian-inspired stew of spinach, chickpeas, turmeric and lemon, with dill rice.
method: Cook rice following the packet instructions. Soften onion in oil in a saucepan for 7 minutes.
Add garlic, turmeric and cumin; cook for 1 minute. Add chickpeas and 150ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach a handful at a time and cook for 3 minutes. Add lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold dill through the rice and serve with the stew and a spoonful of yoghurt.

title: Fresh-Aromatic Thai Green Chicken Curry
blurb: A homemade blend of green chillies, lemongrass, galangal and coriander; no shop-bought curry paste.
ingredients: 1–2 green chillies, deseeded for less heat
1 lemongrass stalk, tough outer layers removed, tender centre finely sliced
15g galangal, peeled and finely chopped (or ginger)
15g fresh coriander, leaves and stems separated
1 tbsp fish sauce (fish and salt only)
method: Cook rice following the packet instructions. Blitz chillies, lemongrass, galangal, shallot, garlic, coriander stems, spices and lime zest with 2–3 tbsp water into a fine homemade paste. Scrape down the blender as needed.
Heat oil in a saucepan and fry the homemade aromatic mixture for 3–4 minutes, stirring.
Add coconut milk and 100ml water; bring to a gentle simmer. Add chicken and cook for 6 minutes.
Add beans and courgette and simmer for 6–8 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through with no pink centre.
Add fish sauce and lime juice to taste. Finish with coriander leaves and basil, and serve with rice.

title: Lemongrass Fish with Rice Noodles & Crunchy Salad
blurb: Pan-fried white fish with fresh lemongrass, ginger and chilli, alongside a lime-dressed noodle salad.
ingredients: 1 lemongrass stalk, tender centre very finely chopped
1 tbsp fish sauce (fish and salt only)
method: Cook noodles following the packet instructions, drain and rinse with cold water.
Rub fish with lemongrass, ginger, garlic and half the chilli. Heat oil in a non-stick pan.
Pan-fry fish for 3–5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until opaque and flaking easily.
Toss noodles, carrot and cucumber with lime juice, fish sauce and remaining chilli. Serve with fish, coriander and peanuts.

title: Ginger Tofu with Broccoli & Peanut Rice
blurb: Golden tofu and broccoli with a quick dressing made from whole peanuts, ginger, lime and soy.
ingredients: 280g firm tofu (soya beans, water and coagulant), drained and cubed
method: Cook rice following the packet instructions. Pat tofu dry with kitchen paper.
Blitz peanuts, half the ginger, garlic, chilli, lime juice, soy sauce and 4 tbsp water into a dressing.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan and fry tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning, until golden.
Add broccoli, remaining ginger and 3 tbsp water. Cover and steam for 4–5 minutes until broccoli is tender.
Stir in the peanut dressing and heat gently for 1 minute, adding water if needed. Serve over rice with spring onions.

title: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowls with Fresh Salsa
blurb: Cumin-lime chicken, peppers and rice, with homemade tomato salsa and plain yoghurt.
ingredients: 1 red onion, half sliced and half finely diced
method: Cook rice following the packet instructions. Toss chicken with cumin, paprika and garlic.
Mix tomatoes, finely diced onion, chilli, coriander and half the lime juice for the salsa.
Heat oil in a large frying pan. Cook sliced onion and peppers for 6 minutes, then add chicken and fry for 8–10 minutes until cooked through with no pink centre.
Add remaining lime juice and season. Serve over rice with salsa and yoghurt.

title: Chilli-Lime Prawns with Sweetcorn & Avocado Rice
blurb: Quick garlic prawns with fresh chilli and lime, charred sweetcorn and an avocado-tomato rice salad.
ingredients: 250g raw peeled prawns, thawed if frozen
method: Cook rice following the packet instructions. Pan-fry sweetcorn in half the oil for 6–8 minutes until cooked and lightly charred.
Transfer corn to a bowl. Heat remaining oil and add garlic, chilli and cumin; stir for 30 seconds.
Add prawns and fry for 3–5 minutes, turning, until pink, firm and opaque throughout. Add half the lime juice.
Mix the freshly cooked rice with corn, avocado, tomatoes, spring onions, coriander and remaining lime juice. Serve immediately with the prawns.

title: Smoky Black Bean & Pepper Rice Skillet
blurb: A one-pan dinner with black beans, peppers, cumin and smoked paprika, finished with lime and yoghurt.
method: Heat oil in a wide lidded pan and cook onion and pepper for 7 minutes. Add garlic, chilli, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add rice, tomatoes, black beans and 200ml boiling water. Stir and season, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook gently for 15–18 minutes until rice is tender, checking once and adding a splash of water if the pan looks dry.
Rest off the heat, covered, for 5 minutes. Finish with lime and coriander and serve with plain yoghurt.

title: Sardine, Tomato & Lemon Wholewheat Pasta
blurb: Plain tinned sardines, sweet tomatoes and lemon make a quick pasta supper with a peppery side salad.
ingredients: 2 x 120g tin sardines in spring water, drained
method: Bring a pan of water to the boil and cook the pasta according to its packet. Reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wide pan. Soften the garlic for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and cook for 8–10 minutes until they collapse.
Gently fold in the drained sardines and heat through for 3–4 minutes, breaking into large flakes.
Toss in the pasta, parsley, lemon zest and enough pasta water to loosen the sauce. Add lemon juice to taste.
Divide between two plates and serve the rocket alongside.

title: Rosemary Chicken with White Beans & Greens
blurb: A tomato and white bean skillet with rosemary chicken and wilted spinach.
method: Heat the oil in a wide lidded pan. Brown the chicken for 4 minutes, then lift onto a plate; it will finish cooking later.
Add the onion and cook gently for 6 minutes, adding a splash of water if needed. Stir in garlic and rosemary for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans and 100ml water. Return the chicken and any juices, cover and simmer for 10–12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the spinach and wilt for 2 minutes. Finish with lemon zest and a squeeze of juice, then divide between two bowls.

title: Lentil & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Bulgur
blurb: Roasted pepper halves filled with lentils, tomatoes and feta, served on lemony bulgur.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Rub the pepper halves with half the oil, place cut-side up in a baking dish and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the drained lentils, tomatoes, spring onions, remaining oil and half the parsley. Spoon into the peppers and top with feta.
Bake for another 15–20 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is piping hot.
Meanwhile, cook the bulgur according to its packet, drain if needed and fluff with a fork. Stir in lemon zest, juice to taste and the remaining parsley.
Serve two pepper halves per person on the bulgur.

title: Lime Cod with Dill & Pea Rice
blurb: Persian-inspired turmeric fish over fragrant dill rice with peas and a cucumber salad.
method: Rinse the rice and cook according to its packet, adding the peas for the final 4 minutes. Drain if needed, cover and leave to steam for 5 minutes.
Mix half the oil with turmeric, garlic and lime zest. Rub over the cod.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan. Cook the cod for 3–5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until opaque and flaking easily.
Toss the cucumber and tomatoes with lime juice and a little dill.
Fold the remaining dill into the rice. Serve the fish over the rice with the salad alongside.

title: Chicken, Apricot & Chickpea Stew
blurb: A Persian-inspired cinnamon and turmeric stew, brightened with lemon and served with a small portion of rice.
method: Heat the oil in a lidded saucepan. Cook the onion and carrots for 6 minutes, then add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Stir in turmeric and cinnamon for 30 seconds. Add 300ml water, the apricots and chickpeas.
Cover and simmer gently for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the carrots are tender. Add a splash of water if it becomes dry.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to its packet and drain if needed.
Stir lemon juice to taste into the stew, scatter with parsley and serve with the rice.

title: Aubergine & Yellow Split Pea Stew
blurb: A meat-free, Persian-inspired tomato stew with roasted aubergine, warming spices and rice.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Toss the aubergine with half the oil, spread on a tray and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in the remaining oil in a saucepan for 6 minutes. Stir in garlic, turmeric and cinnamon for 1 minute.
Add the split peas, tomatoes and 500ml water. Bring to the boil, then simmer partly covered for 35–40 minutes, or until the peas are tender. Older peas may take longer; add water as needed.
Cook the rice according to its packet. Fold the roasted aubergine into the stew and simmer for 3 minutes.
Finish the stew with lemon juice and mint, then serve with the rice.

title: Sesame Haddock with Soba & Pak Choi
blurb: Ginger and sesame fish with buckwheat noodles and crisp green vegetables.
method: Cook the soba noodles according to their packet, then drain and rinse briefly.
Mix the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, half the sesame oil and 2 tbsp water in a wide lidded frying pan.
Lay the haddock in the sauce. Surround with carrots and pak choi stalks, cover and simmer gently for 7–10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Add the pak choi leaves for the final 2 minutes. Lift the fish onto warm plates.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables, pan juices and remaining sesame oil. Serve with the fish, sesame seeds and lime wedges.

title: Chilli & Basil Beef with Green Beans
blurb: A Thai-inspired stir-fry of lean beef, fresh chilli and basil with jasmine rice.
ingredients: 1 tsp fish sauce (fish and salt only)
method: Cook the rice according to its packet. Simmer the green beans in a separate pan for 4 minutes and drain.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, then add the beef.
Break up the beef and cook for 6–8 minutes until cooked through. Add the pepper and beans and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, fish sauce and 2 tbsp water. Stir for 1 minute, then remove from the heat and fold in the basil.
Serve over rice with lime wedges.

title: Tofu & Crunchy Vegetable Peanut Noodles
blurb: Crisp tofu and colourful vegetables in a lime and peanut dressing made from scratch.
method: Pat the tofu dry. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry the tofu for 10–12 minutes, turning until golden on several sides.
Cook the noodles according to their packet, then drain, reserving a little cooking water.
Whisk the peanut butter with soy sauce, ginger, lime juice and 3–4 tbsp warm noodle water to make a pourable dressing.
Add the cabbage and carrots to the tofu pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes, keeping some crunch.
Toss the noodles with the tofu, vegetables and dressing. Scatter with spring onions and coriander.

title: Smoky Salmon with Black Bean & Tomato Rice
blurb: Paprika salmon over lime rice with black beans and a fresh tomato salsa.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Cook the brown rice according to its packet, adding the drained beans for the last 4 minutes to heat through.
Rub the salmon with oil, paprika and cumin. Place on a lined tray and bake for 12–15 minutes until opaque and flaking easily.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, half the coriander and lime juice to make a salsa.
Drain the rice if needed and stir in lime zest and the remaining coriander.
Serve the salmon over the bean rice with salsa and salad leaves.

title: Chicken, Lime & Sweetcorn Soup with Tortilla Strips
blurb: A tomato broth with shredded chicken, sweetcorn and black beans, finished with baked corn tortilla strips.
method: Heat the oven to 190°C fan. Soften the onion in the oil in a lidded saucepan for 6 minutes. Add garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and 500ml water. Submerge the chicken breasts, bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook for 15–20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, slice the tortillas into strips. Spread on a tray and bake for 6–8 minutes until crisp, watching closely.
Lift the chicken onto a clean board and shred with two forks. Return to the pan with the beans and sweetcorn and simmer for 5 minutes until piping hot.
Finish with lime juice and coriander. Serve in two bowls with the tortilla strips on top.

title: Beef, Courgette & Pinto Bean Chilli
blurb: A quick smoky beef and bean chilli with fresh courgette, brown rice and a spoonful of yoghurt.
method: Cook the brown rice according to its packet. Heat the oil in a wide saucepan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up until cooked through. Stir in garlic, chilli, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the courgette, tomatoes, drained beans and 100ml water. Simmer for 15–20 minutes until the courgette is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Finish with lime juice to taste. Serve over rice with a spoonful of yoghurt on each portion.

title: Lemon Salmon, Potato & Broccoli Traybake
blurb: The whole dinner in one roasting tin: golden potatoes, lemony salmon and tender broccoli, with no separate sides to cook.
ingredients: 1 lemon, half sliced and half juiced
method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Use a roasting tin large enough to hold everything in a single layer.
Toss the potatoes in the tin with half the oil, salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes, turning once.
Add the broccoli, garlic and remaining oil. Toss carefully, spreading everything out. Roast for 8 minutes.

Nestle the salmon between the vegetables. Add lemon slices and drizzle with lemon juice. Roast for 12–15 minutes until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily and the potatoes are tender. If needed, lift the cooked salmon onto serving plates and give the potatoes a few more minutes in the same tin.
Scatter with dill and divide the salmon, potatoes and broccoli between two plates. No extra side dish is needed.

title: One-Pot Chicken, Tomato & Spinach Orzo
blurb: Chicken, pasta and vegetables simmer together in one lidded pot. The orzo soaks up the tomato juices as it cooks.
ingredients: 300g boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
method: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy-based lidded pot over a medium heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, turning until lightly browned. It will finish cooking in the pot.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring. Add garlic, oregano and tomato purée and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the orzo, tomatoes and boiling water. Season lightly and bring to a gentle simmer.

Cover and simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring every few minutes so the orzo does not stick. Add a splash more hot water if it gets dry. The orzo should be tender and the chicken cooked through with no pink centre.
Fold in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Rest off the heat for 2 minutes, then add lemon juice to taste and parsley. Serve straight from the pot.

title: One-Pot Golden Chickpea & Spinach Rice
blurb: A Persian-inspired pot of turmeric rice, chickpeas, carrots and spinach, finished with dill and lemon. Everything cooks together on the hob.
ingredients: 1 x 400g tin chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 lemon, half juiced and half cut into wedges
method: Heat the oil in a heavy-based pot with a tight-fitting lid. Soften the onion and carrots over a medium heat for 7–8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add garlic, turmeric and cumin and stir for 1 minute. Add the drained rice and chickpeas and stir gently to coat.

Pour in the boiling water and season. Bring to a simmer, cover tightly and turn the heat very low. Cook for 12–15 minutes until the rice is almost tender and most of the water is absorbed. If the rice is still firm and the pot is dry, add 2–3 tbsp hot water.
Place the spinach on top without stirring. Cover and cook for 2 minutes, then take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff gently with a fork, folding in the wilted spinach, dill and lemon juice to taste. Serve with the lemon wedges. No separate rice or vegetables are needed.
